overlayEntry.notes: Measured 2026-07-27 against the Sui mainnet fullnode pinned at checkpoint 303739938 (2026-07-27T22:52:41Z); journaled evidence: agents/safety-score-v9/data-coverage-wave8-2026-07-27/mech2-drafts/journals/2026-07-27-checkpoint-303739938.json. BUCK total supply 25,965,531.068 (TreasuryCap inside the shared BucketProtocol object 0x9e3dab...d3df; exact match to DefiLlama stablecoin 154). Bucket is in legacy wind-down: the current docs document the v2 USDB system as flagship with Tank and Recovery Mode removed and a 1:1 BUCK->USDB migration; on-chain the v2 PSM Pool<BUCK> (0x4fef507f...e321, 0% swap fees both ways) holds 2,312,140.37 surrendered BUCK, and the USDB Treasury reports 11,577,418.36 USDB across its mint modules. collateralizationRatio 0.146773 is measured on the COMBINED Bucket system because the PSM rail makes BUCK a 1:1 claim on it: (v1 CDP collateral $205,174.97 + v1 reservoir stable pools $69,775.39 + v2 CDP collateral $4,870,747.37 + v2 PSM stable pools $25,223.77) / (BUCK supply net of the migration-pool inventory + USDB supply = 35,230,809.07). v1 reservoir LP tokens (face $3,074,810.29: BUCKETUS/CETABLE Cetus stable LPs, BLUEFIN_STABLE_LP, SCABLE Scallop stable LP) are BUCK-paired and their exogenous content was not established, so they are excluded; the ratio is a measured lower bound (v1-only basis 0.010589; gross-liability basis 0.137733). liquidationCapacityRatio 0.038733 = total v1 Tank BUCK reserves 5,851.78 / v1 CDP debt 151,078.09 (0.000247 against the 23.65M floating BUCK liability). Component grades: collateralizationParameters LIMITED - per-branch MCR 105-150%, recovery thresholds 110-150%, mint ceilings and bottle tables are all documented and read on-chain across 40 buckets (issuer data corroborated by on-chain anchor), but the parameters are currently unenforceable because every oracle is frozen. liquidationMechanics WEAK - measured deficiency: all 40 v1 SingleOracles are stale beyond their 30s tolerance (latest update 2026-07-03, many months older), so v1 price-dependent liquidations fail closed while a measured 22,077.77 BUCK of branch bad debt (WAL 19,601; StakedHouse SUI 1,464; SCA 924; SCALLOP_SCA 88; STSUI 0.4) sits unprocessable. backstop WEAK - measured Tank reserves cover only 3.9% of v1 CDP debt and 26.5% of the measured branch bad debt; the docs' Insurance Fund (funded from protocol revenue) publishes no balance and was not counted. branchIsolation LIMITED - each of the 40 collateral branches has its own Bucket, Tank, SingleOracle and mint ceiling (measured), but all branches share the same threshold-1 Supra/whitelisted-rule oracle pattern, the same admin EOA and package UpgradeCap, and the common BUCK liability. shutdownAndBadDebt WEAK - measured unprocessed bad debt with a frozen liquidation engine and no documented unconditional recapitalization; the v2 migration docs offer position migration, not a residual-deficit settlement path for legacy branches. structuralRedemption WEAK - measured exit depth: v1 reservoir discharge holds ~$69.8k of stablecoins (USDC 59,526; AUSD 7,308; wUSDC 1,592; others ~1.2k), the BUCK->USDB rail is deep but yields USDB (not a USD-stable exit), and the USDB->stable PSM pools hold only USDC 19,914.77 + USDSUI 5,307.90 + USDT 0, so immediate stablecoin exit liquidity is ~$95k against a 23.65M floating BUCK liability; v1 redemption-for-collateral additionally requires the frozen oracles. NOT established: the exogenous (non-BUCK) content of the reservoir LP tokens and of the v2 LP-mint modules (cetus 1.94M, bluefin 1.80M, and smaller modules that minted USDB against LP deposits); any published Insurance Fund balance; any issuer aggregate backing dashboard or stats API (none found at app.bucketprotocol.io); and the identity/timing of any further wind-down steps for the 23.65M floating BUCK.

v1Oracles.note: ALL 40 SingleOracle objects are stale beyond their 30s tolerance at the pin; v1 price-dependent functions (borrow, liquidate, redeem) fail closed. Per-branch price/updateMs recorded in perOracle.

v1Tanks.note: reserve field of each Tank<BUCK,T>; per-tank raw values in source read set (40 objects via sui_multiGetObjects)

v1Reservoirs.note: Reservoir<T> = v1 PSM-style charge/discharge module (buck_minted_amount vs pool of token T). LP tokens are BUCK-paired stable-swap LP wrappers (BUCKETUS/CETABLE = 'SCET-STABLE-LP' Cetus LPs; BLUEFIN_STABLE_LP = Bluefin stable LP; SCABLE = Scallop sUSDC/sUSDT LP); their exogenous (non-BUCK) content was not established and is excluded from measured backing.

psmPoolBUCK.note: v2 PSM Pool<BUCK>; the documented 1:1 BUCK->USDB migration rail (docs: usdb-peg, bucket-upgrade-and-migration)

v2System.note: v2 vault collateral = total_coll_amount field of each Vault<T> from the on-chain SDK config registry 0x03e79aa64ac007d200aefdcb445e31e24f460279bab6c73babfb031b7464072e; sCoin/LST collateral valued at underlying x1.0 (lower bound; sCoin exchange rates >=1)

derived.crBasis: (v1 CDP collateral $205,174.97 + v1 reservoir stable pools $69,775.39 + v2 CDP collateral $4,870,747.37 + v2 PSM stable pools $25,223.77) / (BUCK supply 25,965,531.07 - BUCK held in v2 PSM migration pool 2,312,140.37 + USDB supply 11,577,418.36 = 35,230,809.07). System basis: BUCK is 1:1 convertible to USDB through the measured v2 PSM rail, so residual backing is the combined Bucket system. Excludes v1 reservoir LP tokens (face $3,074,810.29, exogenous content not established) and v2 LP-module deposits (not measured) - the ratio is a measured lower bound. Alternative bases: gross liabilities (no pool netting) 0.137733; v1-only backing/supply 0.010589.
derived.lcrBasis: Total v1 Tank BUCK reserves 5,851.78 / v1 CDP debt 151,078.09 BUCK (per nect-beraborrow precedent: liquidation pool / CDP debt). vs floating BUCK liability 23,653,390.70 the ratio is 0.000247.
derived.badDebtBasis: sum over v1 branches of max(0, debtBuck - collateralUsd at current market prices); unprocessable while all 40 SingleOracles are stale

evidenceSummary: Measured on Sui mainnet at checkpoint 303739938 (2026-07-27T22:52:41Z) via fullnode JSON-RPC and the pinned bucket-interface source. BUCK supply 25,965,531.068 (TreasuryCap, exact DefiLlama match). v1: 40 CDP buckets with 151,078.09 BUCK debt and $205,174.97 collateral at current Pyth prices (branch ratio 1.358; 22,077.77 BUCK measured bad debt across 5 underwater branches), all 40 SingleOracles stale beyond their 30s tolerance (newest 2026-07-03), 18 PSM reservoirs with 3,144,585 BUCK minted outstanding against $69,775 of stablecoins plus $3.07M face of BUCK-paired LP tokens, Tank reserves totalling 5,851.78 BUCK, sBUCK Flask 508,342.43 BUCK. v2 (USDB system, the documented 1:1 migration target): supply 11,577,418.36 USDB; PSM Pool<BUCK> holds 2,312,140.37 surrendered BUCK at 0% fees; USDC/USDSUI/USDT PSM pools hold $25,223.77; 20 CDP vaults hold $4,870,747.37 collateral vs 1,719,802.55 USDB debt (2.832). collateralizationRatio 0.146773 on the combined-system basis (lower bound; LP exogenous content unmeasured); liquidationCapacityRatio 0.038733 (Tank/CDP debt).
